header.title: Billing & subscription
header.description: Manage your plan and top-ups, track usage, and download GST-compliant invoices - all in one place.

pastDue.title: Payment failed - update your card
pastDue.body: We couldn't charge your saved card for the latest renewal. Your plan stays active during a 14-day grace period; after that the workspace is downgraded to trial limits until payment resumes.

topups.heading: Top-ups
topups.description: Need more capacity without changing plans? Buy a top-up - applied to your current billing cycle only.

table.heading: Invoices
table.subtitle: Download a GST-compliant PDF for any invoice
table.emptyBody: Your first invoice appears here after your first payment.

invoices.gstNote: Invoices are GST-inclusive (CGST + SGST for intra-state, IGST for inter-state). Subscription charges are also invoiced by Razorpay; top-up payments are invoiced here.

privacy.intro: The privacy policy published by Sirah Digital that governs your workspace.
privacy.empty: No privacy policy has been published yet.

toast.cancelScheduled: Subscription will end at the current cycle.
toast.pdfError: Could not generate the invoice PDF.
toast.markReadError: Could not mark notifications as read.
toast.razorpayNotConfiguredAdmin: Razorpay is not configured on the backend yet - ask the admin to set RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.
toast.subscribeSuccess: Welcome to {{plan}}! Your subscription is active.
toast.razorpayNotConfigured: Razorpay is not configured on the backend yet.
